name: Tablericons
summary: Browser for free SVG icons with color, size and stroke controls and copy-ready React and Vue components.
description: A searchable library of free SVG icons. Each icon has a detail page with category and tag links, related icons, color/size/stroke-width controls, and tabs that give you the raw SVG code or a React or Vue component to paste.
contains: free SVG icons with a detail page per icon
controls: icon color, size, stroke width (0.5–3)
copy tabs: SVG code, React component, Vue component
category and tag browsing with related icons
